cards.text: The LORD is speaking to His people through Malachi (Malachi 1:1), and He's just called them to return to Him (Malachi 3:7). Now He says, “Your words against Me have been harsh,” and He says they ask, “What have we spoken against You?” Friend, that's like typing “What did I say?” in the group chat when your own message is sitting RIGHT THERE, three texts up.

cards.question: The LORD tells His people exactly what they said against Him. What did they say about serving God?

cards.text: They said they kept His requirements and walked mournfully before the LORD of Hosts, so what did they gain? That's like somebody who hits the gym three times, steps on the scale, and declares exercise a SCAM.

cards.question: The people said, “So now we call the arrogant blessed.”

cards.text: And they said not only do evildoers prosper, they even test God and escape. Hold that thought, friend.

But at that time those who feared the LORD spoke with one another, and the LORD listened and heard them. Friend, the dead batteries I shared that drawer with argued for YEARS over who had the most charge left, and NOBODY was listening to that.

cards.question: So a scroll of ___ was written before the LORD about those who feared Him and honored His name.

cards.text: Then the LORD of Hosts says they will be His on the day He prepares His treasured possession. Friend, read that word again: TREASURED.

cards.question: On that day, how will the LORD treat the people who fear Him?

answers.text: Spare them like a man spares his son
Pay them like a man pays his workers
Move them to a new land of their own

cards.question: The LORD says His people will again distinguish between the ___ and the wicked, between those who serve God and those who do not.

cards.text: Then the LORD of Hosts says, “For behold, the day is coming, burning like a furnace…” I think this part is heavy, friend.

cards.question: On that day, all the arrogant and every evildoer will be ___.

cards.text: The LORD says not a root or branch will be left to them. But then He turns to the ones who fear His name, and the whole picture flips.

cards.question: For those who fear the LORD's name, something will rise with healing in its wings. What is it?
Those who fear the LORD's name will also go out and ___ like calves from the stall.

cards.text: Calves bursting out of the stall, that's me every morning when the ovens warm up, hopping around on my gold base like the angel just called me out of that old junk drawer YESTERDAY.
Then the LORD says those who fear His name will trample the wicked, for they will be ashes under the soles of their feet on the day He is preparing.

cards.question: Then the LORD tells His people to remember something they've had for a long time. What is it?

answers.text: The law of His servant Moses
The songs of His servant David
The dreams of His servant Joseph

cards.text: That's the statutes and ordinances He commanded Moses at Horeb for all Israel. Then the LORD looks ahead to the great and awesome Day of the LORD, and says He'll send someone before it comes.

cards.question: Who will the LORD send before the great and awesome Day of the LORD?
Elijah will turn the hearts of the ___ to their children, and the hearts of the ___ to their fathers.

cards.text: Otherwise, the LORD says, He will come and strike the land with a curse. And that's the very last line of the whole book of Malachi, friend.
